rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: Insufficient. The single provided guideline supports the required framework but does not constitute program-level evidence that SGL-001 has established MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV assays, completed GMP-like batches with release/stability, developed a stability-indicating potency assay correlated to in vivo PD, performed formulation/device compatibility testing with intact-EV recovery, or generated non-rodent intranasal biodistribution with orthogonal controls. All those items are gaps that must be closed before high-confidence cross-species intact-EV PK/PD comparisons.
findings: Only a field-wide expert guideline (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) was provided; no SGL-001 program-specific CMC, analytical validation, batch, stability, formulation-compatibility, or non-rodent biodistribution data were supplied.

MISEV2023 recommends orthogonal characterization, defined source-cell controls (e.g., MCB/WCB), validated intact-EV assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy), stability-indicating potency assays correlated to in vivo PD, GMP-like scale-up comparability, formulation/device compatibility, and orthogonal controls for biodistribution—these are prerequisites for confident cross-species intact-EV PK/PD bridging.
The supplied evidence set does not demonstrate that SGL-001 has met the program-specific CMC/analytics requirements recommended by MISEV2023.
objections: The only supplied evidence is the MISEV2023 guidance; it does not include any program-specific CMC, analytical validation, batch, stability, formulation-compatibility, or non-rodent biodistribution data required to justify advancing SGL-001 lots/formulations for cross-species intact-EV PK/PD bridging. Therefore the proposed Stage-1 advancement is not supported by the available evidence set.

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not advance SGL-001 lots or formulations for cross-species intact-EV PK/PD bridging until the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package is assembled and submitted. Required deliverables: (1) MCB/WCB establishment and characterization reports with seed-lot control; (2) defined orthogonal QC panel and fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV assays (report LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) with SOPs; (3) ≥3 GMP-like scale-up batch records with in-process controls, lot-release data, and accelerated/real-time stability demonstrating reproducible identity and potency across lots; (4) a stability-indicating potency assay with documented correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint (including assay performance and statistical correlation); (5) formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact-EV recovery ex vivo/in vivo with appropriate negative/orthogonal controls; (6) non-rodent intranasal biodistribution/toxicity studies with orthogonal controls that attribute signal to intact EV. Initiate targeted collection of these documents; do not proceed with cross-species bridging activities until reviewed program-specific evidence meets the above criteria. Any major therapeutic advancement decision based on these data requires human approval and should remain pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) recommends transparent, orthogonal characterization, defined source-cell controls (e.g., MCB/WCB), validated intact-EV assays, and mechanism-linked potency/stability assays as best-practice prerequisites for advancing EV formulations for cross-species bridging. The allowed evidence set for this review contains only that guideline and does not include program-specific CMC/analytics deliverables; therefore, confirmation that SGL-001 has met those program-specific requirements is not available in the supplied evidence (see evidence_gap).
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC/analytics deliverables (MCB/WCB records, assay validation reports with LLOQ/specificity/precision, GMP-like batch release and stability data, intact-EV recovery in formulation/device compatibility studies, and large-animal intact-EV biodistribution with orthogonal controls) are missing from the supplied evidence.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 supports that robust production controls and orthogonal analytics are necessary to de-risk identity and reproducibility. The allowed evidence for this review does not include manufacturing execution records for SGL-001; therefore, claims that SGL-001 materials do or do not demonstrate characterized MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production cannot be confirmed from the supplied evidence alone (see evidence_gap).
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing manufacturing execution records: MCB/WCB establishment, process scale-up data, in-process controls, release specifications, and reproducibility analyses across batches.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) provides consensus support for requiring an orthogonal QC and validated intact-EV analytic package before high-confidence cross-species intact-EV PK/PD bridging. The allowed evidence set for this review contains only that guideline and does not include SGL-001-specific empirical validation or in vivo bridging data; therefore, whether SGL-001 has executed or met those controls/assays cannot be determined from the supplied evidence (see evidence_gap).
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Absence of program-specific analytics validation, intact-EV-specific in vivo controls, and non-rodent biodistribution/toxicity studies in the supplied evidence.

verification_objections: Statements asserting that SGL-001 program-specific deliverables are present or absent (e.g., that MCB/WCB records, validated intact‑EV assay reports with LLOQ/specificity/precision/accuracy, three GMP‑like batch release and stability data, stability‑indicating potency assay correlated to in vivo PD, formulation/device intact‑EV recovery studies, and non‑rodent intranasal biodistribution with orthogonal controls are available) are unsupported by the supplied evidence set.
Any claim that SGL‑001 materials demonstrate characterized source‑cell MCB/WCB, scalable/reproducible production, or completed assay validations cannot be confirmed from the provided guideline alone.

Assertions comparing SGL‑001 rodent biodistribution to large‑animal or cross‑species translatability based on program data are unsupported because no program biodistribution/toxicity studies are included in the allowed evidence.
